name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.12 Antenna Flow
author: James
description: Series card-edit restoration release. v0.22.12 removes the v0.22.10 Series detail/Lens toolbar experiment from the active bundle and restores the earlier per-item workflow: every Series card in the Series library receives its own native Jellyfin EDIT metadata action using that card's exact Series ID, server ID and type. The edit pill appears on hover/focus and remains remote/touch accessible. v0.22.9 API-backed Collections grid and curated remote artwork picker, source-aware TMDb collection completeness through the optional Velvet Antenna Bridge, direct Add/Remove collection membership, v0.22.8 navigation reliability, permanent player EXIT, first-paint Home, Tonight, right-click administration and CC+ subtitle search remain included.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.11 CC+ Persistence Hotfix
author: James
description: Small compatibility hotfix for Antenna Flow. Keeps the Velvet Antenna CC+ subtitle-search launcher available during playback even when Jellyfin hides its native CC selector because no local subtitle tracks exist. Leaves Jellyfin's native subtitle availability and selection logic untouched.
